plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness for Claude Code: a marker-driven edit gate keeps the repo read-only until a Mermaid-first Markdown plan — checked against a per-repo constitution and a light pre-approval review — is approved, then implementation runs subagents-first by default (SDD). An ask-first context gate steers long sessions to a clean hand-off without ever erasing a prompt. State lives in-repo under .mentor/.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest a session (or every un-harvested session of a project) into reusable Claude Code artifacts, audit an existing plugin from one session to fix how it misbehaved, learn from every session that used a plugin — or one named session — with both audit + enhance lenses, opt in to usage tracking that makes learning instant, and publish releases with synced manifests.
